description: The strike bank — THIS PIECE'S since 2026-10-09: the composer's 60 strikes, played by him on the mallets lane (marimba) and saved as scores/strikes.json, ingested by tools/strike_db.js (RUNNING_LOG §290). In piece #5 this held his recorded piano strikes, the seed of that piece's opening. The Strikes drawer and the harmony bank 'strikes' read this file live.
_provenance: Skeleton written by the port from piece 6 (decibel_TENOR_2026 @ 9796edd), 2026-10-20 — the new-piece protocol's 3.4. The strike bank is EMPTY: piece 6's 60 strikes (his marimba takes) stayed in its repo. Recorded strikes are a piece's own. CARRIED 2026-11-09 (his word, RUNNING_LOG §128): the strike banks of Scattered Substance (septet_2026: ScatteredStrikes01, his keyboard into the piano lane, 2026-09-03) and Approaching (decibel_TENOR_2026: his 60 marimba strikes, 2026-10-09) WHOLE — every strike keeps its id, its notes (midi · vel · the source lane and instKey as provenance) and its timing; the drawer deals the pitches to THIS ensemble by its own rules. The sources are named on every strike (_from).
